name: Taxually For WooCommerce
author: taxually

sections.description:
The more your store grows, the more tax obligations follow.

Selling into new countries or US states triggers VAT registrations, nexus thresholds, monthly filing deadlines, and remittance to tax authorities across multiple jurisdictions. Most merchants deal with it through spreadsheets, accountants, and a background hum of compliance anxiety. Taxually takes it off your plate entirely.

Stop spending hours on tax returns

Connect your WooCommerce store once and your transaction data syncs to Taxually automatically every month. No CSV exports. No manual uploads. No back-and-forth with your accountant. The filing admin disappears — you focus on your business.

Registration, filing, and representation in one place

Most tax tools stop at checkout. Taxually handles what comes after: VAT and sales tax registration, accurate monthly filings, and direct representation with tax authorities where legally required. From your first nexus trigger to audit defence, it’s covered.

Real tax experts behind the platform

Taxually isn’t just software. Our team of tax professionals manages your filings directly and represents you with tax authorities when needed. Trusted by 20,000+ companies including Razor Group, Gelato, and Amer Sports.

“We reduced VAT compliance staff from ten to three.” — Razor Group
“Saving 20–30 hours per month in VAT preparation.” — Gelato
“Volumes of queries from tax authorities are dropping.” — Amer Sports

Expand internationally without becoming a tax expert

EU VAT across all 27 member states, UK, Norway, and Switzerland. US sales tax across all states. Australia GST and other international jurisdictions. Fiscal representation where legally required. Whether you’ve just triggered your first VAT obligation or you’re managing filings across dozens of jurisdictions, Taxually scales with you.

60–80% cheaper than managing it manually

Clear per-jurisdiction pricing. No enterprise contracts. Self-service onboarding in under an hour.

Get started

Install the plugin, connect your Taxually account, and you’re done. Visit taxually.com to set up your account or book a demo.

External services

This plugin connects to the Taxually API to enable OAuth-based authentication and to allow Taxually to pull your WooCommerce transaction data for tax compliance purposes.

Taxually API

The plugin communicates with the following Taxually API endpoint:

  • Production: https://taxually-api.azurewebsites.net

What data is sent and when:

During the connection flow, the plugin sends the following data to the Taxually API:

  • Your store URL and store display name
  • A PKCE code challenge (a one-time cryptographic value used to secure the OAuth flow)
  • WooCommerce REST API credentials (consumer key and secret), which are transmitted once at the end of the OAuth flow so Taxually can pull order data from your store

No data is sent until you explicitly initiate the connection by clicking “Connect to Taxually” in the plugin settings. Once connected, Taxually accesses your store data (orders, products, customer addresses) directly via the WooCommerce REST API on a scheduled basis for tax compliance processing.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually
  3. Click “Connect to Taxually” and sign in with your Taxually account
  4. Specify your fulfilment location(s)
  5. You’re connected — Taxually pulls your transaction data automatically each month and handles compliance from there

Don’t have a Taxually account yet? Sign up at taxually.com or book a demo. Most merchants are up and running in under an hour.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin affect my checkout or break anything?

No. The plugin is a data connector — it syncs your transaction data to Taxually in the background. It makes no changes to your checkout flow, pricing, or existing tax settings.

What if I already have a tax calculation tool handling my checkout?

Taxually works alongside checkout calculation tools. If checkout tax is already handled, Taxually covers what those tools don’t: the filing and remittance after the transaction. Many merchants use both.

How quickly does data start syncing?

Your first sync happens on the next monthly cycle after connection. From then on, Taxually pulls your transaction data automatically — no action needed from you.

Is my store data secure?

Yes. The plugin uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE authentication. Your credentials are generated on connection and immediately revoked when you disconnect. Taxually is trusted by 20,000+ businesses globally.

Do I need to be a tax expert to use this?

No. Self-service onboarding takes under an hour. Taxually’s tax professionals handle the complexity — you just connect your store and specify your fulfilment locations.

Does this plugin calculate tax at checkout?

Not currently — the plugin handles automated data sync for filing and compliance purposes. Checkout tax calculation is on the roadmap. If you already have checkout tax calculation in place, Taxually handles everything after: registration, filing, and representation.

What countries are covered?

EU VAT: all 27 EU member states, UK, Norway, and Switzerland. US sales tax: all states with obligations. Australia GST and additional international jurisdictions.

Can I disconnect at any time?

Yes. Disconnect from the plugin settings at any time — this immediately revokes Taxually’s API access to your store.

Where are the plugin settings?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
